summary: The Grid is an inference API that routes requests by quality tier, with an OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible endpoint and a beta Anthropic Messages endpoint. Usage is prepaid: fund the account and spend credits per request. The homepage states new accounts get a $5 signup credit and that all unused signup credits and bonuses expire 14 days after signup. The docs quickstart separately mentions a $25 limited-time signup credit; the homepage figure is used here.
claim_steps: Sign up for a new account at https://app.thegrid.ai/sign-up
Use the signup credit within 14 days of signup
